method: Analytic scanline boundary intersections on the exact simplified A/V/T/L/I construction geometry used by the current T021 harness; kerning OFF; units are font units at 1000 UPM.

classification.AV_VA: Construction-level whitespace is extremely large in all three hypotheses; B is not validated merely because its advance sits between A and C.
classification.TA_AT: Large and strongly height-dependent whitespace indicates that pair-specific residuals cannot yet be separated cleanly from primitive glyph construction.
classification.LI_IL: Strong directional asymmetry at middle/high scanlines is caused by L/I construction geometry; this is a drawing/base-spacing diagnostic, not a kerning authorization.

limits: Simplified research glyphs, not production outlines.
No kerning values are proposed from these numbers.
